name: infiniterm
title: Infiniterm
description: Open Finder folders in infiniterm, in a workspace you pick or a new one.
author: tarikkavaz

commands.name: open-in-infiniterm
commands.title: Open in Infiniterm
commands.subtitle: Infiniterm
commands.description: Open the Finder selection (or the front Finder window) in a workspace you choose, or a new one.

commands.name: new-terminal-card
commands.title: New Terminal Card
commands.subtitle: Infiniterm
commands.description: Open a new terminal card in a directory you choose (home by default), in a workspace you pick or a new one.

commands.name: open-file
commands.title: Open File in Infiniterm
commands.subtitle: Infiniterm
commands.description: Open the file selected in Finder as an editor card.

commands.name: open-diff
commands.title: Open Git Diff in Infiniterm
commands.subtitle: Infiniterm
commands.description: Show the git changes of the Finder selection (or the front Finder window's folder) as a diff card.

commands.name: send-to-card
commands.title: Send Text to Card
commands.subtitle: Infiniterm
commands.description: Type a command or text into a chosen terminal card without moving the focus.

commands.name: run-saved-command
commands.title: Run Saved Command in Card
commands.subtitle: Infiniterm
commands.description: Save commands once, then send one to any terminal card. Add, edit and delete them here.

commands.name: go-to-card
commands.title: Go to Card
commands.subtitle: Infiniterm
commands.description: Pick a card from any workspace and bring it on screen. Needs an ift with the focus verb.

commands.name: open-in-current-workspace
commands.title: Open in Infiniterm (Current Workspace)
commands.subtitle: Infiniterm
commands.description: Open the Finder selection (or the front Finder window) on the workspace on screen.

preferences.name: iftPath
preferences.title: ift Path
preferences.description: Path to the ift binary. Raycast has a minimal PATH, so use an absolute path.
